addition: The [Bohm dossier](../../dossiers/bohm.md) **extends** Account re-entering source-field at register 3 through three distinct returns: explication retains the conditions of a local form; dialogical suspension makes an operative assumption available for inquiry; an institutional encounter lets a contribution change another participant’s next conditions while retaining its originating authority. The physics interpretation, dated conversation and later SEED programme keep their separate carriers. This gives the fourth operation a concrete consequence: a correction must be able to alter the receiving account and its use. No common lexical descent or shared phenomenal subject follows from that coordination.
